definitions.SPECIFIED: A reviewed contract or design exists.
definitions.SCAFFOLDED: Code or files exist, but deterministic installation is not yet proven.
definitions.CONFIGURED: Required local configuration and credential references resolve.
definitions.VERIFIED: Doctor and module tests passed with observed evidence.
definitions.OPERATIONAL: External readback and fresh-session acceptance passed.
definitions.DEGRADED: A formerly operational module is failing and declares a repair action.
